_comment: Every `continue-on-error` site in .github/workflows/, minus the LSP nightly (tool-smoke.yml), with the reason it may read green without proving it evaluated anything (#4518). A `floored` row names the step in the same job that carries the floor and the exact text proving it there; the floor step must NOT be continue-on-error, or the floor gates nothing. A `no-floor` row states the reader that makes an empty result visible instead. tests/config/nightly-evaluated-floors.test.ts derives the population from the YAML and fails closed on a site this file does not name, and on a workflow's raw `continue-on-error` key count disagreeing with the parsed one. Measured floors behind the `floored` rows live in measurements.json (nonLspFloors) where a run measured them.

lspNightly.reason: The LSP nightly. #4514 floors its four best-effort producers in one gating step (tool-smoke job, 'LSP evaluated floor') that reads their records and the committed docs, and tests/config/nightly-evaluated-floors.test.ts pins that step, its position after every producer, and the four producers' continue-on-error. Its other continue-on-error sites (setup actions, the notify jobs, the refresh-PR steps) are the same shapes as the rows here but sit in the workflow this issue excluded, so #4514's tests own them.

ci.yml#targeted-tests-advisory.reason: A pull request that touches no test-covered source legitimately matches zero test files, so a count floor would red a docs-only PR. scripts/pre-push-targeted-tests.mjs logs every file it matched nothing for ('[pre-push] no tests matched <file>'), the job is advisory by its name suffix, and a job-level continue-on-error still lets its check row read failure.

ci.yml#install-test#POSIX case-insensiti.reason: The anchors stay advisory about test RESULTS, and the non-continue-on-error floor step below them reds the leg when fewer than 100 tests executed (223 on the measured macOS leg; measurements.json nonLspFloors).

ci.yml#install-test#Rule catalog report.reason: The reporter runs scripts/validate-rule-catalog.mjs over rules/rule-catalog.json and the rule trees, both checked in, and exits non-zero on drift. tests/scripts/rule-language-case.test.ts spawns the same script on fixture repos and asserts its findings in the gating Unit lane, so a validator that stopped reporting cannot pass unnoticed.

compat-smoke.yml#compat-smoke#Layer A —.reason: The alert job reads its step outcome. Any non-success (contract drift, an infra failure, or a crash before it verified anything) files or refreshes ONE tracking issue by fixed title, and a green run closes that issue, so an empty layer is never silent.

compat-smoke.yml#compat-smoke#Layer B —.reason: The alert job reads its step outcome the same way as Layer A: a crash, a failed install or a wrong light-mode decision files or refreshes the tracking issue, and a clean run closes it.

compat-smoke.yml#compat-smoke-alert#Aler.reason: Tracker maintenance. Gating the notifier would let an issue-upsert failure mask the smoke's own verdict, which the job outputs already carry; a failed upsert shows as this step's outcome in the run log.

install-smoke.yml#scope.reason: A fail-open classifier, not a producer. A failed job leaves outputs.smoke empty, and pi-load reads empty as 'not false', so the full matrix runs: the green path cannot skip the work this job scopes.

install-smoke.yml#lsp-handshake.floorStep: LSP handshake layer (install + spawn + initialize each server)
install-smoke.yml#lsp-handshake.reason: The job stays advisory (continue-on-error plus its name suffix), and its one graded step carries --min-pass=35: an unavailable server reports a skipped row, never a failure, so a run where every toolchain install failed would exit 0 having proved nothing. 35 sits under both measured PR runs (41 and 40; measurements.json nonLspFloors).

install-smoke.yml#lsp-handshake#erlef/se.reason: A toolchain install. An absent Elixir reports skipped handshake rows (run 38641583432), which the --min-pass=35 floor counts, so gating the install would red a PR for a runner-image change rather than for pi-lens.

install-smoke.yml#mise-repro.reason: A leg either runs the whole pi session through scripts/rpc-load-check.mjs or its step exits non-zero, so 'evaluated nothing' has no green spelling: a leg that installed nothing has no pi for the last step to drive. The header above the job in install-smoke.yml states this, and the failing leg's check row is the signal.

install-smoke.yml#host-latest-smoke#Reso.reason: Its step outcome reaches host-latest-notify through the job outputs. A resolve failure files or refreshes the tracker issue by fixed title, and a clean run closes it.

install-smoke.yml#host-latest-smoke#Inst.reason: Its step outcome reaches host-latest-notify through the job outputs. A failed install files or refreshes the tracker issue by fixed title, and a clean run closes it.

install-smoke.yml#host-latest-smoke#Pin.reason: Its step outcome reaches host-latest-notify through the job outputs. A failed pin files or refreshes the tracker issue by fixed title, and a clean run closes it.

install-smoke.yml#host-latest-smoke#Down.reason: Its step outcome reaches host-latest-notify through the job outputs. A failed grammar download files or refreshes the tracker issue by fixed title, and a clean run closes it.

install-smoke.yml#host-latest-smoke#Buil.reason: Its step outcome reaches host-latest-notify through the job outputs. A failed dist build files or refreshes the tracker issue by fixed title, and a clean run closes it.

install-smoke.yml#host-latest-smoke#Pack.reason: Its step outcome reaches host-latest-notify through the job outputs. A failed npm pack files or refreshes the tracker issue by fixed title, and a clean run closes it.

install-smoke.yml#host-latest-smoke#Inst.reason: Its step outcome reaches host-latest-notify through the job outputs. A failed tarball install files or refreshes the tracker issue by fixed title, and a clean run closes it.

install-smoke.yml#host-latest-smoke#Self.reason: Its step outcome reaches host-latest-notify through the job outputs. A failed bun selftest files or refreshes the tracker issue by fixed title, and a clean run closes it.

install-smoke.yml#host-latest-notify#Not.reason: Tracker maintenance. The notifier reads all eight host-latest-smoke step outcomes, files or refreshes the tracker on any failure and closes it on green; gating the gh upsert itself would mask the lane's verdict.

lint.yml#jscpd.reason: jscpd's exit code is the whole verdict (threshold 1) over four fixed in-repo paths: a missing path exits 1, and only a .jscpd.json format or ignore edit can empty the scan. The header above the job in lint.yml states this.

lint.yml#complexity.reason: scripts/complexity-report.mjs calls the shared assertEvaluated with COMPLEXITY_ANALYZED_FILES_FLOOR, so a run that analyses too few source files exits non-zero and the graded step reds; set -o pipefail keeps a crash behind the pipe from reading green.

lint.yml#strictness.reason: The job only publishes the two tsc counts. The gating tests/config/strictness-ratchet.test.ts runs the same two configurations and reds on exit 0, zero diagnostics or any drift, so a tsc that evaluated nothing reds the Unit lane. The header above the job states this.

lint.yml#yamllint.reason: The file list is git ls-files of the checkout, and yamllint with an empty list exits 2 (usage), so an empty population reds the row instead of reading clean. The header above the job states this.

lint.yml#typos.reason: crate-ci/typos walks the checkout and exits non-zero on any finding or error; the population is the repo itself and cannot be empty. The header above the job states this.

lint.yml#taplo.reason: npm run taplo feeds git ls-files '*.toml' to taplo, which exits non-zero on a parse error or format drift; only a pathspec edit can empty the match. The header above the job states this.

parser-smoke.yml#parser-smoke#Save the m.reason: A cache-write step (mode: save). The graded step above it carries --min-pass=11, and losing the cache costs a cold install on the next run, not a verdict.

stryker-nightly.yml#mutate#Mutate this s.reason: Exploratory by design and gates nothing (#4005). The gating 'Fail the shard when the driver failed' step turns a failed shard red, and scripts/stryker-nightly.mjs combine classifies a shard with no report, another shard's report or an unreadable report as failed and lists every incomplete range in the tracking-issue body.

stryker-pertest.yml#mutate#Mutate the mo.floorStep: List tests that kill no mutant
stryker-pertest.yml#mutate#Mutate the mo.reason: The mutant count is the verdict, not the report's presence: Stryker writes {"files":{}} and exits 0 for a range with nothing to mutate, so the always() candidates step judges the count through assert-evaluated.mjs --floor 1 and its exit status reds the run. Pinned by tests/scripts/floor-steps-executed.test.ts.
